name: Monte Carlo simulation
domain: 结构可靠度与随机分析
definition_zh: 以重复随机抽样和计算估计响应统计特征的方法。
usage_overview: 常用于随机动力响应与结构可靠性分析，通过大量随机样本估计响应分布、概率密度或统计矩，并为概率计算、代理模型及其他近似方法提供数值比较基准，以检验其计算结果。

complete_examples.text: Monte Carlo simulation (MCS) [1,2] is a direct numerical method for solving the statistical properties and PDFs of responses of nonlinear stochastic oscillators by generating the excitation sample, integrating the nonlinear equations numerically and obtaining the response sample finally.

The numerical analysis illustrates that the extended EPC method is valid and efficient for achieving the non-stationary nonzero mean PDFs of the responses for the system with strong nonlinearity by comparing the results obtained by extended EPC method, equivalent linearization method and Monte Carlo simulation method.
In this analysis, the results estimated from Monte Carlo Simulation (MCS) method are provided as the exact values for comparison.
